domain(person,[aliyah]).

% Aliyah trusts her instinct.
axiom(s1, trusts_instinct(aliyah)).

% Aliyah has strong intuition.
axiom(s2, strong_intuition(aliyah)).

% Anyone who speaks confidently or writes clearly can communicate complex ideas.
axiom(s3, rule([or(speaks_confidently(X),writes_clearly(X))],can_communicate_complex_ideas(X))).

% If Aliyah meets deadlines, then she either collaborates well or works independently, but not both.
axiom(s4, rule([meets_deadlines(aliyah)],xor(collaborates_well(aliyah),works_independently(aliyah)))).

% If Aliyah collaborates well, then she has strong intuition and can communicate complex ideas.
axiom(s5, rule([collaborates_well(aliyah)],and(strong_intuition(aliyah),can_communicate_complex_ideas(aliyah)))).

% Aliyah does not work independently.
axiom(s6, not(works_independently(aliyah))).

% Aliyah either thinks logically or trusts her instinct, but not both.
axiom(s7, xor(thinks_logically(aliyah),trusts_instinct(aliyah))).

% Aliyah does not evaluate data effectively.
axiom(s8, not(evaluates_data_effectively(aliyah))).

% If Aliyah makes accurate conclusions, then she either thinks logically or evaluates data effectively (but not both).
axiom(s9, rule([makes_accurate_conclusions(aliyah)],xor(thinks_logically(aliyah),evaluates_data_effectively(aliyah)))).

% If someone is accurate, then they are either precise in measurements or reliable in findings (or both).
axiom(s10, rule([accurate(X)],or(precise_in_measurements(X),reliable_in_findings(X)))).

% For Aliyah, being able to communicate complex ideas and being reliable in findings are mutually exclusive.
axiom(s11, not(and(can_communicate_complex_ideas(aliyah),reliable_in_findings(aliyah)))).

% Everyone who approaches problems systematically either thinks logically or considers multiple perspectives (or both).
axiom(s12, rule([approaches_problems_systematically(X)],or(thinks_logically(X),considers_multiple_perspectives(X)))).

% Aliyah does not have attention to detail.
axiom(s13, not(has_attention_to_detail(aliyah))).

% Aliyah is accurate or innovative.
axiom(s14, or(accurate(aliyah),innovative(aliyah))).

% Aliyah meets deadlines.
axiom(s15, meets_deadlines(aliyah)).

% If Aliyah is precise in measurements, then she either has attention to detail or makes accurate conclusions (but not both).
axiom(s16, rule([precise_in_measurements(aliyah)],xor(has_attention_to_detail(aliyah),makes_accurate_conclusions(aliyah)))).
